purpose: Authorized role can use a function it is authorized for.
preconditions: A Student user (UG or PG) exists and is authenticated.
action_or_input: Student requests a function/record in their own role scope (e.g., view own leave status).
expected_result: Access is permitted and the student's own data is returned.

purpose: A role is denied a function it is not authorized for.
preconditions: A Student user is authenticated.
action_or_input: Student attempts an HoD-only function (e.g., approve a leave application).
expected_result: Access is denied; no state change occurs.

purpose: A user cannot access a record outside their data scope.
preconditions: Student A and Student B each have a leave application; Student A is authenticated.
action_or_input: Student A requests Student B's leave application record.
expected_result: Access is denied; Student B's data is not returned.

purpose: A triggered notification obligation is sent via both system alert and email.
preconditions: A student exists with a valid email address.
action_or_input: Student submits a leave application (a request-submission notification obligation).
expected_result: A system-generated alert and an email notification are both generated for the student.

purpose: HoD can approve a leave application.
preconditions: A submitted leave application exists; HoD is authenticated.
action_or_input: HoD approves the leave application.
expected_result: Leave decision is recorded as approved by the HoD.

purpose: HoD can reject a leave application.
preconditions: A submitted leave application exists; HoD is authenticated.
action_or_input: HoD rejects the leave application.
expected_result: Leave decision is recorded as rejected by the HoD.

purpose: A non-HoD role cannot approve/reject a leave application.
preconditions: A submitted leave application exists; Academic Administrator is authenticated.
action_or_input: Academic Administrator attempts to approve the leave application.
expected_result: Action is denied; leave application remains undecided.

purpose: Academic Administrator verifies and approves a bonafide request.
preconditions: A submitted bonafide request exists; Academic Administrator is authenticated.
action_or_input: Academic Administrator verifies and approves the request.
expected_result: Request is recorded as approved by the Academic Administrator.

purpose: Academic Administrator verifies and rejects a bonafide request.
preconditions: A submitted bonafide request exists; Academic Administrator is authenticated.
action_or_input: Academic Administrator verifies and rejects the request.
expected_result: Request is recorded as rejected by the Academic Administrator.

purpose: A role other than Academic Administrator cannot verify/decide a bonafide request.
preconditions: A submitted bonafide request exists; HoD is authenticated.
action_or_input: HoD attempts to approve the bonafide request.
expected_result: Action is denied; request status is unchanged.

purpose: Download is permitted for an approved bonafide request.
preconditions: A bonafide request approved by the Academic Administrator exists; the requesting student is authenticated.
action_or_input: Student requests download of the bonafide certificate.
expected_result: Download is permitted and the certificate is delivered.

purpose: Download is refused while the bonafide request is not yet approved.
preconditions: A submitted, not-yet-decided bonafide request exists; the requesting student is authenticated.
action_or_input: Student requests download of the bonafide certificate.
expected_result: Download is refused; no certificate is delivered.

purpose: Download is refused for a rejected bonafide request.
preconditions: A bonafide request rejected by the Academic Administrator exists; the requesting student is authenticated.
action_or_input: Student requests download of the bonafide certificate.
expected_result: Download is refused; no certificate is delivered.

purpose: Librarian can record clearance for the Library domain.
preconditions: A no-dues request exists routed to all seven domains; Librarian is authenticated.
action_or_input: Librarian opens the request and records a clearance result for the Library domain.
expected_result: The Library clearance result is recorded.

purpose: Hostel Warden can record clearance for the Hostel domain.
preconditions: A no-dues request exists routed to all seven domains; Hostel Warden is authenticated.
action_or_input: Hostel Warden opens the request and records a clearance result for the Hostel domain.
expected_result: The Hostel clearance result is recorded.

purpose: Mess In-charge can record clearance for the Mess domain.
preconditions: A no-dues request exists routed to all seven domains; Mess In-charge is authenticated.
action_or_input: Mess In-charge opens the request and records a clearance result for the Mess domain.
expected_result: The Mess clearance result is recorded.

purpose: authorized Department verifier of the student's department can record clearance for the respective Department domain.
preconditions: A no-dues request exists routed to all seven domains; authorized Department verifier of the student's department is authenticated.
action_or_input: authorized Department verifier of the student's department opens the request and records a clearance result for the respective Department domain.
expected_result: The respective Department clearance result is recorded.

purpose: Lab Supervisor can record clearance for the Lab domain.
preconditions: A no-dues request exists routed to all seven domains; Lab Supervisor is authenticated.
action_or_input: Lab Supervisor opens the request and records a clearance result for the Lab domain.
expected_result: The Lab clearance result is recorded.

purpose: authorized Academic Section verifier can record clearance for the Academic Section domain.
preconditions: A no-dues request exists routed to all seven domains; authorized Academic Section verifier is authenticated.
action_or_input: authorized Academic Section verifier opens the request and records a clearance result for the Academic Section domain.
expected_result: The Academic Section clearance result is recorded.

purpose: authorized Student Section verifier can record clearance for the Student Section domain.
preconditions: A no-dues request exists routed to all seven domains; authorized Student Section verifier is authenticated.
action_or_input: authorized Student Section verifier opens the request and records a clearance result for the Student Section domain.
expected_result: The Student Section clearance result is recorded.

purpose: An authority cannot record clearance for another authority's domain.
preconditions: A no-dues request exists; Librarian is authenticated.
action_or_input: Librarian attempts to record a clearance result for the Hostel domain.
expected_result: Action is denied; Hostel status is unchanged.

purpose: A verifier of a different department cannot record the student's Department clearance.
preconditions: A no-dues request exists for a student of Department X; an authorized Department verifier of Department Y is authenticated.
action_or_input: Department Y verifier attempts to record the Department clearance for the student.
expected_result: Action is denied; the student's Department status is unchanged.

purpose: Recording one authority's result updates only that domain and leaves the other six unchanged.
preconditions: A no-dues request exists with all seven statuses pending.
action_or_input: Librarian records 'clear' for Library; then Mess In-charge records 'not clear' for Mess.
expected_result: After the first action only Library is clear and the other six are unchanged; after the second action Mess is not clear, Library remains clear, and the other five are unchanged.

purpose: Finalization is allowed when all seven authorities have submitted and all are clear.
preconditions: A no-dues request exists with all seven authority results recorded as clear; Academic Administrator is authenticated.
action_or_input: Academic Administrator attempts to finalize no-dues clearance.
expected_result: Finalization is allowed and the request is recorded as finalized.

purpose: Finalization is refused when not all seven authorities have submitted verification.
preconditions: A no-dues request exists where six authorities recorded 'clear' and one (e.g., Lab) has not submitted; Academic Administrator is authenticated.
action_or_input: Academic Administrator attempts to finalize no-dues clearance.
expected_result: Finalization is refused; the request is not finalized.

purpose: Finalization is refused when all seven have submitted but at least one result is not clear.
preconditions: A no-dues request exists where all seven authorities submitted and six are 'clear' but one (e.g., Hostel) is 'not clear'; Academic Administrator is authenticated.
action_or_input: Academic Administrator attempts to finalize no-dues clearance.
expected_result: Finalization is refused; the request is not finalized.

purpose: No-dues certificate download is refused before finalization.
preconditions: A no-dues request exists that has not been finalized; the student is authenticated.
action_or_input: Student requests the no-dues certificate download.
expected_result: Download is refused; no certificate is delivered.

purpose: No-dues certificate download is permitted after finalization.
preconditions: A no-dues request finalized by the Academic Administrator exists; the student is authenticated.
action_or_input: Student requests the no-dues certificate download.
expected_result: Download is permitted and the certificate is delivered.

purpose: A PG student can submit an assistantship claim.
preconditions: A PG student is authenticated.
action_or_input: PG student submits an assistantship claim.
expected_result: Claim submission is accepted and the claim is recorded.

purpose: A non-PG (UG) student cannot submit an assistantship claim.
preconditions: A UG student is authenticated.
action_or_input: UG student attempts to submit an assistantship claim.
expected_result: Submission is refused; no claim is recorded.

purpose: Both role-verifications are recorded when different faculty verify in Thesis-then-TA order.
preconditions: A submitted claim exists; Faculty F1 is the assigned Thesis Supervisor and Faculty F2 is the assigned TA Supervisor.
action_or_input: F1 verifies as Thesis Supervisor, then F2 verifies as TA Supervisor.
expected_result: Both the Thesis Supervisor verification and the TA Supervisor verification are recorded.

purpose: No order is prescribed: both verifications are recorded in TA-then-Thesis order.
preconditions: A submitted claim exists; Faculty F1 is the assigned Thesis Supervisor and Faculty F2 is the assigned TA Supervisor.
action_or_input: F2 verifies as TA Supervisor, then F1 verifies as Thesis Supervisor.
expected_result: Both role-verifications are recorded; the reverse order is accepted.

purpose: The same faculty member holding both roles can record both role-verifications.
preconditions: A submitted claim exists; Faculty F1 is both the assigned Thesis Supervisor and the assigned TA Supervisor.
action_or_input: F1 verifies the claim as Thesis Supervisor and also verifies it as TA Supervisor.
expected_result: Both role-verifications are recorded.

purpose: Thesis Supervisor verification alone does not replace the TA Supervisor verification.
preconditions: A submitted claim exists; F1 is the assigned Thesis Supervisor and F2 is the assigned TA Supervisor.
action_or_input: Only F1 verifies as Thesis Supervisor.
expected_result: Thesis Supervisor verification is recorded; the TA Supervisor verification remains outstanding and the claim is not treated as fully verified.

purpose: TA Supervisor verification alone does not replace the Thesis Supervisor verification.
preconditions: A submitted claim exists; F1 is the assigned Thesis Supervisor and F2 is the assigned TA Supervisor.
action_or_input: Only F2 verifies as TA Supervisor.
expected_result: TA Supervisor verification is recorded; the Thesis Supervisor verification remains outstanding and the claim is not treated as fully verified.

purpose: Department Administrator review is blocked when no supervisor verification exists.
preconditions: A submitted claim exists with no supervisor-role verification; Department Administrator is authenticated.
action_or_input: Department Administrator attempts to review/forward the claim.
expected_result: Action is refused; the claim does not enter department review.

purpose: Department Administrator review is blocked when only one supervisor role is verified.
preconditions: A submitted claim exists with only the Thesis Supervisor role verified; Department Administrator is authenticated.
action_or_input: Department Administrator attempts to review/forward the claim.
expected_result: Action is refused; the claim does not enter department review.

purpose: Department Administrator review is allowed once both supervisor roles are verified.
preconditions: A claim exists with both Thesis Supervisor and TA Supervisor role-verifications recorded; Department Administrator is authenticated.
action_or_input: Department Administrator reviews and forwards the claim to HoD.
expected_result: Review is allowed and the claim is forwarded to HoD.

purpose: HoD can approve an assistantship claim after review.
preconditions: A claim forwarded by the Department Administrator exists; HoD is authenticated.
action_or_input: HoD approves the claim.
expected_result: Claim is recorded as approved by the HoD.

purpose: HoD can reject an assistantship claim after review.
preconditions: A claim forwarded by the Department Administrator exists; HoD is authenticated.
action_or_input: HoD rejects the claim.
expected_result: Claim is recorded as rejected by the HoD.

purpose: A non-HoD role cannot approve/reject an assistantship claim.
preconditions: A claim forwarded by the Department Administrator exists; Academic Administrator is authenticated.
action_or_input: Academic Administrator attempts to approve the claim as the departmental decision.
expected_result: Action is denied; the claim remains undecided.

purpose: Stipend processing is permitted for an HoD-approved claim.
preconditions: An HoD-approved claim exists; Academic Administrator is authenticated.
action_or_input: Academic Administrator opens the claim for stipend processing and processes it.
expected_result: Processing is permitted and recorded.

purpose: Stipend processing is refused for an HoD-rejected claim.
preconditions: An HoD-rejected claim exists; Academic Administrator is authenticated.
action_or_input: Academic Administrator attempts stipend processing on the claim.
expected_result: Processing is refused; no stipend processing is recorded.

purpose: Stipend processing is refused for a claim without an HoD approval.
preconditions: A claim forwarded to HoD and awaiting HoD decision exists; Academic Administrator is authenticated.
action_or_input: Academic Administrator attempts stipend processing on the claim.
expected_result: Processing is refused; no stipend processing is recorded.

purpose: The accepted assistantship progression is followed end to end.
preconditions: A PG student's submitted claim exists with assigned Thesis and TA Supervisors, Department Administrator, HoD and Academic Administrator available.
action_or_input: Thesis Supervisor and TA Supervisor verify (either order); Department Administrator reviews/forwards; HoD approves; Academic Administrator processes the stipend.
expected_result: Each step is accepted in this sequence and the claim ends as stipend-processed.

purpose: HoD decision cannot bypass Department Administrator review.
preconditions: A claim with both supervisor verifications recorded but not yet reviewed/forwarded by the Department Administrator exists; HoD is authenticated.
action_or_input: HoD attempts to approve the claim.
expected_result: Action is refused; the claim is not approved.

purpose: HoD decision cannot bypass the required supervisor verifications.
preconditions: A submitted claim with no supervisor-role verification exists; HoD is authenticated.
action_or_input: HoD attempts to approve the claim.
expected_result: Action is refused; the claim is not approved.

purpose: Department Administrator records a thesis-supervisor assignment.
preconditions: A PG student and a faculty member exist; a departmental decision is available; Department Administrator is authenticated.
action_or_input: Department Administrator records the thesis-supervisor assignment of the faculty member to the student.
expected_result: The thesis-supervisor assignment is recorded.

purpose: TA assignment is recorded with a course/subject only.
preconditions: A PG student and a course exist; a departmental decision specifies the course only; Department Administrator is authenticated.
action_or_input: Department Administrator records the TA assignment with the course/subject only.
expected_result: The TA assignment is recorded with the course/subject and no faculty target.

purpose: TA assignment is recorded with a faculty member only.
preconditions: A PG student and a faculty member exist; a departmental decision specifies the faculty member only; Department Administrator is authenticated.
action_or_input: Department Administrator records the TA assignment with the faculty member only.
expected_result: The TA assignment is recorded with the faculty target and no course/subject.

purpose: TA assignment is recorded with both course/subject and faculty member.
preconditions: A PG student, a course and a faculty member exist; a departmental decision specifies both; Department Administrator is authenticated.
action_or_input: Department Administrator records the TA assignment with both the course/subject and the faculty member.
expected_result: The TA assignment is recorded with both the course/subject and the faculty target.

purpose: A role other than Department Administrator cannot record assignments.
preconditions: A PG student and a faculty member exist; a Student user is authenticated.
action_or_input: The student attempts to record a thesis-supervisor assignment.
expected_result: Action is denied; no assignment is recorded.

purpose: Both roles are resolved for the claimant and both verifications are required when one faculty member holds both roles.
preconditions: A submitted claim exists for a PG student whose Thesis Supervisor and TA Supervisor are the same faculty member F1.
action_or_input: F1 views the claim for verification.
expected_result: Both the Thesis Supervisor role and the TA Supervisor role are resolved for F1 for this claim, as two distinct required verifications.

purpose: A single verification by a dual-role faculty member does not satisfy both roles.
preconditions: A submitted claim exists whose Thesis Supervisor and TA Supervisor are the same faculty member F1; Department Administrator is available.
action_or_input: F1 verifies only in the Thesis Supervisor role; then Department Administrator attempts to review/forward the claim.
expected_result: TA Supervisor role-verification remains outstanding and Department Administrator review is refused.

purpose: A PG student can initiate a graduate seminar scheduling request.
preconditions: A PG student is authenticated.
action_or_input: PG student submits a seminar scheduling request.
expected_result: The request is accepted and recorded.

purpose: A non-PG (UG) student cannot initiate a seminar scheduling request.
preconditions: A UG student is authenticated.
action_or_input: UG student attempts to submit a seminar scheduling request.
expected_result: Request is refused; none is recorded.

purpose: Department Administrator schedules and logs a seminar with no separate approval stage.
preconditions: A PG seminar request awaiting scheduling exists; Department Administrator is authenticated.
action_or_input: Department Administrator schedules the seminar.
expected_result: Seminar is scheduled and logged directly, with no approval step required.

purpose: A non-Department Administrator cannot schedule a seminar.
preconditions: A PG seminar request awaiting scheduling exists; the requesting PG student is authenticated.
action_or_input: The PG student attempts to schedule the seminar.
expected_result: Action is denied; the seminar remains unscheduled.

purpose: A PG student can view seminar schedules.
preconditions: A scheduled seminar exists; a PG student is authenticated.
action_or_input: PG student requests to view the seminar schedule.
expected_result: Viewing is permitted and the schedule is shown.

purpose: A faculty member can view seminar schedules.
preconditions: A scheduled seminar exists; a faculty member is authenticated.
action_or_input: Faculty member requests to view the seminar schedule.
expected_result: Viewing is permitted and the schedule is shown.

purpose: A role that is neither PG student nor faculty cannot view seminar schedules.
preconditions: A scheduled seminar exists; a UG student is authenticated.
action_or_input: UG student requests to view the seminar schedule.
expected_result: Viewing is denied.
